Delhi High Court orders son, daughter-in-law to vacate elderly man's home

The Delhi High Court has ordered a son and daughter-in-law to vacate the home of an 85-year-old man, stating that children cannot force parents to live with them. The court overturned previous orders from the District Magistrate and Divisional Commissioner. The High Court ruled that senior citizens do not need to prove "harassment" to evict their children from their self-earned property, citing the elderly man's statement that "both trouble me." The son and daughter-in-law have been given four weeks to vacate the property.
